svg.title: Example: AI Working Agreement
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape AI working agreement: where the team uses AI, guardrails, quality and review, skills and sharing, risks, impact measures, and a review schedule.
svg.text: Agree how the team uses AI tools: where it helps, the guardrails, how output is reviewed, and how you'll know it's working.
Form the Team · Responsible Use · Human Review · Measure the Impact · Review It Often
Only approved tools for work data
No confidential, customer or personal data in unapproved tools
A person reviews AI output before it's used or shipped
We say when work is substantially AI-assisted
We check sources, facts and licences
AI-assisted code gets the same review and tests as any code
The person who uses AI owns the result
Reviewers can ask how output was produced
Additions to our Definition of Done:
Try: cycle time · defects found later · review time · rework · team confidence
“Where does AI genuinely help us, and where does it get in the way?”
“Would we be comfortable explaining how this was made?”
Form the Team · Working Agreements · Responsible Use

g.text: AI-assisted changes are labelled in the pull request
Generated tests are read and understood, not just run
A person checks facts and figures in customer copy
Time to write tests for a story
Faster, but check the edge cases
